gizmo.title: Akwụkwọ egwu
gizmo.description: Na-egosi ma na-akpọ akwụkwọ egwu, taabụ guitar, na ndetu egwu site na alphaTex ma ọ bụ MusicXML.

configure.title: Ndetu AlphaTex
configure.description: Ederede alphaTex n'ahịrị maka akwụkwọ egwu. Dezie ya ozugbo iji dee ndetu; e chekwara ya na template ka ohere wee dịgide.

configure.title: Faịlụ egwu
configure.description: Bulite ma ọ bụ jikọọ na faịlụ MusicXML (.xml/.musicxml/.mxl) ma ọ bụ Guitar Pro (.gp3/.gp4/.gp5/.gpx/.gp). Ọ na-anọchi alphaTex n'ahịrị mgbe edobere ya.

advanced.title: Ịkpọ ụda
advanced.description: Agbanyere na ndabara - gee ntị n'akwụkwọ egwu a na-akpọ site na synthesizer arụnyere n'ime. Gbanyụọ ya maka ọnọdụ naanị nlele (enweghị ụda).

advanced.title: Gosi nhọrọ ngosi
advanced.description: Gosi bọtịnụ mbugharị, ịgbatị, na nhazi na ogwe ihe ọkpụkpọ.

advanced.title: Gosi bọtịnụ mbupụ
advanced.description: Gosi bọtịnụ nbudata MIDI na mbipụta/PDF na ogwe ihe ọkpụkpọ.
